dct_description_sm:
Areas of land in the Province that have never been sold by the Crown or have had all rights given back to the Crown through forfeiture. Includes lands with a tenant, temporary or short term rights. Includes Crown Leases, Land Use Permits, Licences of Occupation, Easements, and Beach Management Agreements.
